import re

A = re.compile(r'^(?P<id>\d+)\s+(?P<app>\S+)\s+(?P<state>[A-Z]+)\s+(?P<type>[A-Z]+)\s+(?:(?P<flag>[A-Z]+)\s+)?(?P<src>[^\s\[]+)\[(?P<sport>\d+)\]/(?P<zone>[^/\s]+)/(?P<proto>\d+)(?:\s+\((?P<tip>[^\[\s]+)\[(?P<tport>\d+)\]\))?\s*$')
B = re.compile(r'^(?P<vsys>\S+)\s+(?P<dst>[^\s\[]+)\[(?P<dport>\d+)\]/(?P<zone>[^/\s]+)(?:\s+\((?P<tip>[^\[\s]+)\[(?P<tport>\d+)\]\))?\s*$')
SKIP = re.compile(r'^\s*(-{5,}|\S+@\S+[>#]|ID\s+Application|Vsys\s+Dst)')

def parse(lines):
    rows = []
    used = []
    skip = []
    cur = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        if SKIP.search(l):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = A.match(l)
        if m:
            cur = {'ID': m.group('id'), 'Application': m.group('app'), 'State': m.group('state'), 'Type': m.group('type'), 'Flag': m.group('flag') or '', 'Src': m.group('src'), 'Sport': m.group('sport'), 'Src Zone': m.group('zone'), 'Proto': m.group('proto'), 'Src translated IP': m.group('tip') or '', 'Src translated Port': m.group('tport') or '', 'Vsys': '', 'Dst': '', 'Dport': '', 'Dst Zone': '', 'Dst translated IP': '', 'Dst translated Port': ''}
            rows.append(cur)
            used.append(i)
            continue
        m = B.match(l)
        if m and cur is not None and cur['Dst'] == '':
            cur['Vsys'] = m.group('vsys')
            cur['Dst'] = m.group('dst')
            cur['Dport'] = m.group('dport')
            cur['Dst Zone'] = m.group('zone')
            cur['Dst translated IP'] = m.group('tip') or ''
            cur['Dst translated Port'] = m.group('tport') or ''
            used.append(i)
            continue
    blocks = []
    if rows:
        blocks.append({'name': 'sessions', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': rows})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
